# earningsfollower

> Research tool for U.S. equity earnings season: a free calendar and a paid morning brief.

## Product

- Free: earnings calendar — who reports, timing (BMO/AMC), themes, market cap, options-implied move estimates.
- Pro ($9.99/month): Morning brief — one ranked focus setup with action, watch, and drop-if; short secondary board; what changed; who’s reporting today.
- Not financial advice. Not an autotrader. Not a generic “AI stock picker.”

## Key URLs

- https://www.earningsfollower.com/ — marketing overview
- https://www.earningsfollower.com/calendar — free earnings calendar
- https://www.earningsfollower.com/brief — morning brief (Pro; preview for unpaid)
- https://www.earningsfollower.com/pricing — subscribe / manage billing
- https://www.earningsfollower.com/how-it-works — product walkthrough
- https://www.earningsfollower.com/faq — FAQ

## Concepts traders ask about

- Earnings calendar with implied move
- Post-earnings drift research
- Peer / theme earnings waves
- Session focus setup with invalidation (drop-if)
